topic.name: HER2
topic.short_description: Growth factor receptor overexpressed in breast and gastric cancers
topic.seo_title: HER2 in Cancer Research - Latest Studies & Findings | Your Cancer Breakthroughs
topic.seo_description: Explore HER2 cancer research, biomarkers, and diagnostics. Discover latest studies on HER2-positive breast and gastric cancers, targeted treatments, and clinical advances.
topic.seo_intro:
HER2 (human epidermal growth factor receptor 2) is a protein that plays a critical role in the growth and development of certain cancer cells. When HER2 is overexpressed—meaning cancer cells produce abnormally high levels of this protein—it can fuel rapid cell growth and division. This occurs in approximately 15-20% of breast cancers and a significant portion of gastric cancers, making HER2 status one of the most important biomarkers in modern oncology. Understanding HER2 expression has revolutionized cancer diagnosis and treatment, allowing doctors to identify which patients may benefit from targeted therapies specifically designed to block HER2 signaling.

Research into HER2 continues to advance at a rapid pace, with scientists working to develop new diagnostic tools, targeted medications, and combination therapies that can more effectively treat HER2-positive cancers while minimizing side effects. Recent studies have expanded our knowledge about HER2 mutations, resistance mechanisms, and how to better predict treatment response. For patients and caregivers navigating a HER2-positive cancer diagnosis, staying informed about the latest research developments is essential for understanding treatment options and emerging clinical trials.

On this page, you'll find the latest peer-reviewed research articles on HER2 as a cancer biomarker and diagnostic tool. These studies represent the cutting edge of scientific investigation into how HER2 testing and targeted approaches are improving cancer outcomes.

articles.title: A Phase Ib/II Trial of Lenvatinib Plus Pembrolizumab Plus Fulvestrant in ER-positive/ HER2- Negative Metastatic Breast Cancer
articles.hook: Lenvatinib plus pembrolizumab plus fulvestrant shows efficacy in ER-positive metastatic breast cancer
articles.summary: A three-drug combination of lenvatinib, pembrolizumab, and fulvestrant is being tested for safety and effectiveness in metastatic ER-positive breast cancer.

articles.title: A Phase 3, Multicenter, Randomized, Open-Label, Active-Controlled Study of Trastuzumab Deruxtecan (T-DXd) Versus Trastuzumab Emtansine (T-DM1) in Participants With High-Risk HER2-Positive Primary Breast Cancer Who Have Residual Invasive Disease in Breast or Axillary Lymph Nodes Following Neoadjuvant Therapy (DESTINY-Breast05)
articles.hook: Trastuzumab deruxtecan outperforms T-DM1 in HER2-positive breast cancer
articles.summary: A new drug, trastuzumab deruxtecan, is tested against an older treatment for HER2-positive breast cancer patients with remaining disease after chemotherapy.

articles.title: Adjuvant Dynamic Marker - Adjusted Personalized Therapy Comparing Endocrine Therapy Plus Ribociclib Versus Chemotherapy in Intermediate Risk, HR+/HER2- Early Breast Cancer
articles.hook: Ribociclib plus endocrine therapy outperforms chemotherapy in intermediate-risk breast cancer
articles.summary: A trial testing whether ribociclib plus hormone therapy works better than chemotherapy for intermediate-risk early breast cancer in women.

articles.title: A Phase III,Multicenter,Randomized,Open-Label,Active-Controlled Trial of A166 Versus Trastuzumab Emtansine (T-DM1) in Patients With HER2-Positive Unresectable or Metastatic Breast Cancer Previously Treated With Trastuzumab and Taxane Therapy
articles.hook: A166 outperforms T-DM1 in HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer
articles.summary: A166 is being tested against T-DM1 to treat HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer in patients who previously received trastuzumab and taxane therapy.

articles.title: A Randomized, Open-label, Multicenter Phase 3 Study of SKB264 Versus Treatment of Physician's Choice (TPC) in Patients With Unresectable Locally Advanced, Recurrent or Metastatic HR+/HER2- Breast Cancer Who Had Failed at Least One Line of Chemotherapy
articles.hook: SKB264 versus physician's choice treatment for advanced HR+/HER2- breast cancer
articles.summary: Study tests SKB264 drug against standard treatment for advanced hormone-receptor-positive breast cancer patients who failed chemotherapy.

articles.title: A Phase 2 Open-label Basket Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Orally Administered Reversible Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitor BAY 2927088 in Participants With Metastatic or Unresectable Solid Tumors With HER2-activating Mutations
articles.hook: BAY 2927088 targets HER2-mutant solid tumors across multiple cancer types
articles.summary: A new oral drug called BAY 2927088 is being tested to treat multiple solid tumors with HER2 mutations by blocking abnormal cancer cell growth.

articles.title: A Pilot Study Utilizing a HER2 Directed Dendritic Cell Vaccine During Neoadjuvant Therapy of HER2+ Breast Cancer
articles.hook: HER2-directed dendritic cell vaccine enhances neoadjuvant therapy in breast cancer
articles.summary: A personalized immune vaccine made from a patient's own cells boosts the body's ability to fight HER2+ breast cancer during chemotherapy treatment.

articles.title: ELACESTRANT in Women and Men With CDK4/6 Inhibitor-Naive Estrogen Receptor Positive, HER-2 Negative Metastatic Breast Cancer: An Open-Label Multicenter Phase 2 Study (ELCIN)
articles.hook: Elacestrant demonstrates efficacy in CDK4/6 inhibitor-naive ER-positive metastatic breast cancer
articles.summary: Elacestrant shows efficacy and safety in treating advanced estrogen receptor-positive breast cancer in patients who haven't received prior CDK4/6 inhibitors.

articles.title: Omission of Sentinel Lymph Node Biopsy in Triple-negative and HER2-positive Breast Cancer Patients With Radiologic and Pathologic Complete Response in the Breast After Neoadjuvant Systemic Therapy: a Single-arm, Prospective Surgical Trial.
articles.hook: Skipping sentinel lymph node biopsy safe in chemotherapy-responsive breast cancer
articles.summary: Breast cancer patients with complete response to chemotherapy can skip lymph node surgery without affecting survival outcomes.

articles.title: A Randomized Trial of Neoadjuvant THP vs TCHP for HER2-amplified/Positive Breast Cancer (NeoTHERa)
articles.hook: THP chemotherapy achieves superior pathologic complete response in HER2-positive breast cancer
articles.summary: Study compares two chemotherapy combinations for HER2-positive breast cancer to determine which achieves better tumor elimination before surgery.
